title: Residue theorem on a rectangle with a simple pole, by splitting into holomorphic + principal part
intent: Reduce the integral of a function with a simple pole to two already-proved facts by rewriting the integrand on the border as a holomorphic part g plus the principal part A/(s-p), then integrating the sum term by term: the holomorphic part vanishes and the principal part is the residue theorem.
also_known_as: split integrand into holomorphic + principal part

parent.name: ResidueTheoremOnRectangleWithSimplePole
parent.statement:
lemma ResidueTheoremOnRectangleWithSimplePole {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {z w p A : ℂ}
    (zRe_le_wRe : z.re ≤ w.re) (zIm_le_wIm : z.im ≤ w.im)
    (pInRectInterior : Rectangle z w ∈ 𝓝 p) (gHolo : HolomorphicOn g (Rectangle z w))
    (principalPart : Set.EqOn (f - fun s ↦ A / (s - p)) g (Rectangle z w \ {p})) :
    RectangleIntegral' f z w = A

children.name: RectangleIntegral'_congr
children.statement:
theorem RectangleIntegral'_congr (h : Set.EqOn f g (RectangleBorder z w)) :
    RectangleIntegral' f z w = RectangleIntegral' g z w
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: RectangleIntegral' f z w = RectangleIntegral' g z w when f and g agree on the rectangle border.

children.name: HolomorphicOn.rectangleBorderIntegrable
children.statement:
theorem HolomorphicOn.rectangleBorderIntegrable (hf : HolomorphicOn f (Rectangle z w)) :
    RectangleBorderIntegrable f z w
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: A function holomorphic on the rectangle is rectangle-border-integrable.

children.name: HolomorphicOn.rectangleBorderIntegrable'
children.statement:
theorem HolomorphicOn.rectangleBorderIntegrable'
    (hf : HolomorphicOn f (Rectangle z w \ {p})) (hp : Rectangle z w ∈ nhds p) :
    RectangleBorderIntegrable f z w
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: A function holomorphic on the punctured rectangle, with p in the interior, is rectangle-border-integrable.

children.name: RectangleBorderIntegrable.add
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The rectangle integral of f + g is the sum of the rectangle integrals, when both are border-integrable.

children.name: HolomorphicOn.vanishesOnRectangle
children.statement:
theorem HolomorphicOn.vanishesOnRectangle [CompleteSpace E]
    {U : Set ℂ} (f_holo : HolomorphicOn f U)
    (hU : Rectangle z w ⊆ U) :
    RectangleIntegral f z w = 0
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: A function holomorphic on a set containing the rectangle has zero rectangle integral.

children.name: ResidueTheoremInRectangle
children.statement:
theorem ResidueTheoremInRectangle
    (zRe_le_wRe : z.re ≤ w.re) (zIm_le_wIm : z.im ≤ w.im)
    (pInRectInterior : Rectangle z w ∈ 𝓝 p) :
    RectangleIntegral' (fun s => c / (s - p)) z w = c
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The primed rectangle integral of c / (s - p) over a rectangle with p in its interior is c.

applicability.goal_shape: RectangleIntegral' f z w = A, where f is given (via a Set.EqOn hypothesis) as a holomorphic function g plus a principal part A/(s-p) on the rectangle minus the pole p, with p in the rectangle interior and g holomorphic on the whole rectangle.
applicability.use_when: the integrand's behaviour is stated as a holomorphic part plus a simple-pole principal part, and each part already has its own integral lemma (a vanishing lemma for the holomorphic part, a residue lemma for the principal part) plus an integrability lemma for each summand.
applicability.avoid_when: the pole has higher order (the principal part is not a single A/(s-p)); the pole lies on the border (the principal part is then not border-integrable); the holomorphic-part and principal-part lemmas are stated for a different rectangle or orientation than the one the congruence produces.

The authors state the proof plan in the blueprint attribute above the lemma: 'Replace f with g + A/(s-p) in the integral. The integral of g vanishes by Lemma HolomorphicOn.vanishesOnRectangle. To evaluate the integral of 1/(s-p), pull everything to a square about the origin using Lemma RectanglePullToNhdOfPole, and rescale by c; what remains is handled by Lemma ResidueTheoremAtOrigin.'

The main theorem's glue cites 6 project lemmas directly (RectangleIntegral'_congr, HolomorphicOn.rectangleBorderIntegrable, HolomorphicOn.rectangleBorderIntegrable', RectangleBorderIntegrable.add, HolomorphicOn.vanishesOnRectangle, ResidueTheoremInRectangle), and the longest chain of project lemmas below the main theorem is 7 long (ResidueTheoremInRectangle -> ResidueTheoremAtOrigin' -> integral_const_div_re_add_self -> integral_const_div_self_add_im -> integral_self_div_sq_add_sq -> continuous_self_div_sq_add_sq -> sq_add_sq_ne_zero).

consequences: The move creates a congruence obligation (that f equals g + A/(s-p) on the border, discharged by RectangleIntegral'_congr), an integrability obligation for each summand (g via HolomorphicOn.rectangleBorderIntegrable, the principal part via HolomorphicOn.rectangleBorderIntegrable'), and a linearity step (RectangleBorderIntegrable.add) before the two per-part lemmas can be applied. Each of the holomorphic-part and principal-part lemmas must be stated for exactly the rectangle and orientation the congruence produces; if the pole is not simple, or lies on the border, the principal part is not border-integrable and the split fails.
